work.author: GREGORIUS PP. XVI.
work.description: Letter CXCVII (protocol GREGORIUS PP. XVI. ad futuram rei memoriam LF34212–34215) gives Prince Clemens von Metternich an altar made from the marble remains of the burnt Ostian basilica with the relics of the martyr Boniface, grants it a privileged-altar indulgence and a plenary indulgence on stated feasts, and ends with the perpetual-validity clause and its own 29 January 1833 closing at LF34266. Its note 1 (Ex Bullario Romano) is LF34269 and the next page's running title LF34272, before numeral CXCVIII at LF34275. Issuer evidence is GREGORIUS PP. XVI. at LF34212–34212; the source closing at LF34263–34266 reads: Datum Romae apud sanctum Petrum sub annulo piscatoris die vigesima nona ianuarii millesimo octingentesimo trigesimo tertio, pon- tificatus Nostri anno secundo. Exact source extent and surrounding boundaries were inspected as uncorrected OCR; no complete print-image collation or historical authentication is claimed.
